terrain.name: TrailSurface
terrain.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square ground texture, top-down orthographic, for Korean mountain training trail in a pixel-art game. Weathered irregular flat gray-brown granite stones embedded in warm dry earth with sparse moss in cracks, larger broken flat stepping stones toward center, tiny pine needles. Seamlessly tileable, no perspective, no horizon, no props, no text, no border. Handcrafted luxurious 32-bit pixel-art, crisp deliberate clusters and stepped muted highlights, rich walnut shadows and dusty sage, subtle golden daylight, low contrast overall. Uniform texel scale across entire tile.

assets.name: MountainDistance
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final panoramic background texture for a Korean martial arts pixel-art rhythm game. Wide 16:9 landscape. A majestic remote Korean mountain valley viewed from a high mountainside, layers of craggy blue-sage ridges descending into pale mist, small traditional tiled-roof dojo far below near a winding river in the lower left, sweeping golden morning sky in upper half, gentle cloud banks, distant sharp summit at right. No close foreground objects, no people, no path, no UI, no text. Painterly handcrafted pixel-art in the spirit of a luxurious 32-bit wuxia game: crisp intentional pixel clusters, jagged silhouettes, restrained dithering, muted celadon green, slate blue, parchment gold, deep ink shadows. Detailed and atmospheric, not vector, not photoreal, not a blurry painting. Horizon at 42% from top. Keep central vertical region quiet and low contrast. Flat edge-to-edge artwork, no frame. This is one distant layer; foreground trees rocks and mist will be separate animated objects.

assets.name: NatureAtlas
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for Korean martial-arts pixel-art game, on genuinely transparent background. Square image divided into four equal quadrants with generous transparent gaps; no grid lines, no text, no scene backdrop. Upper-left: tall rugged mossy granite cliff crag, narrow, vertical, warm gray and deep ink shadow, visible whole silhouette and feet. Upper-right: complete wind-bent Korean pine tree with reddish bark and broad angular celadon-green needle clusters, visible root base, isolated tree. Lower-left: full mossy rounded boulder with roots, grasses and ferns around feet, a dense low horizontal rock garden cluster. Lower-right: open weathered Korean wooden gateway with tiled upturned eaves and two posts, no doors, no fence, full silhouette. All sprites viewed frontally from human eye level, not isometric. Handcrafted rich 32-bit pixel art, deliberate visible square pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, subtle dither shading, consistent golden upper-left light. Dark sage, warm stone, rich walnut, muted pale-gold accents; no neon, no Japanese torii, no blossoms, no characters. Each sprite strictly contained within its own quadrant and disconnected from others, centered with 8% padding per cell.

assets.name: TrainingCourt
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final 16:9 environment backdrop for Korean wuxia pixel-art game. First-person human eye-level view inside an intimate open-air martial arts training court high in the mountains. Antique Korean timber pavilion beams and eaves frame the top and side edges, aged stone tiles and low wooden training platform in the foreground, celadon pine branches beyond a low plaster wall, layers of misty mountains behind the wall, cloth training banners hanging only at extreme far left and right edges. Warm golden late-afternoon side light across walnut timber and stone, tranquil powerful atmosphere. Large empty foreground training space: NO wooden dummy, NO human, NO hands, NO text, NO HUD, NO controls. Center is quiet dark muted stone and wall to support separately composited dummy and rhythm-game lanes. Meticulous lavish 32-bit pixel art, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped shadows, restrained dithering, beautiful handpainted texture and composition, coherent deep ink shadows and parchment-gold highlights. No Japanese torii, no cherry blossoms, no photorealism, no vector. Edge-to-edge art.

assets.name: DummyAtlas
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation parts sheet on genuinely transparent background for first-person Korean martial arts pixel-art game. Square image, exactly 3 columns x 3 rows of isolated detached parts, generous empty transparent gutters, no grid, no labels. Top row left: vertical cylindrical walnut training-dummy HEAD cap, blunt rounded top, visible grain, no face. Top row middle: thick cylindrical wooden dummy UPPER TORSO log, front view, warm honey wood, two dark circular joint holes. Top row right: thick cylindrical wooden dummy LOWER TORSO log, front view, matching upper torso width, dark base rim. Middle row left: short thick wooden striking arm peg projecting diagonally toward viewer and left, wooden joint sphere at base. Middle row middle: matching arm peg projecting toward viewer and right. Middle row right: heavy wooden training-dummy round base on two chunky feet, front view. Bottom row left: first-person LEFT clenched fist and forearm, knuckles toward upper-right as if punching forward, wrapped tan wrist, dark indigo martial-arts sleeve entering from bottom-left. Bottom row middle: first-person RIGHT clenched fist and forearm, knuckles toward upper-left, tan wrist wraps, matching indigo sleeve entering from bottom-right. Bottom row right: a cluster of three distinct long jagged broken wood splinters, separate and not touching. Every part fully inside its cell, no cropped edges, no assembled dummy. Rich handcrafted 32-bit pixel art matching a luxurious dojo game: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped golden highlights from upper left, deep walnut and ink shadows, visible wooden grain, limited palette. No vector, no plastic 3D, no photo, no captions, no background.
